program.name: AliExpress WW
program.description:
Для трафика из стран СНГ (без Украины) создана отдельная партнерская программа AliExpress RU&CIS NEW. Заказы с кликом и со страной доставки СНГ не регистрируются в программе. Если большая часть вашего трафика (больше 50%) за прошедший календарный месяц была получена по странам из региона RU&CIS, то следует перевести весь трафик в оффер AliExpress RU&CIS NEW.

Список еженедельных акций.AliExpress – один из крупнейших мировых маркетплейсов, предлагающий клиентам самые низкие цены, а также выбор из более чем 100 миллионов товаров от 200 тысяч продавцов, 20 самых популярных способов оплаты и доставку в более чем 200 стран.

Преимущества для веб-мастеров:


	Процент подтверждения более 90%
	Мировая известность бренда
	Нет ограничений по ГЕО
	Бесплатная/дешевая доставка
	Принимаются все основные виды оплат
	Высокие тарифы


Преимущества для покупателей:


	Более 100 млн. товаров
	Более 200 тыс. продавцов
	Низкие цены
	Бесплатная доставка практически на все товары
	Более 20 способов оплаты
	Безопасные переводы: продавец получает деньги только после подтверждения заказа
	Клиентская поддержка 24/7
	Мультиязычные сайты AliExpress


Hot Products

 Основное правило начисления вознаграждения за Hot Products: переход должен быть осуществлен по рекламному материалу из инструмента/фида Hot Product или по ссылке, сгенерированной Admitad Bot. В случае если переход был осуществлен по основной ссылке (ru.aliexpress.com, aliexpress.com) или по ссылке на обычный товар, будет применено стандартное вознаграждение.

Хотим обратить ваше внимание на внесение изменений в правила атрибуции для Hot Products. Подробнее с новыми правилами атрибуции можно ознакомиться здесь.

Вы можете найти фид Hot Products в разделе “Товары” в меню программы.

Уведомляем вас об изменении политики AliExpress в отношении расширений браузера (plug-ins, add-ons, extensions) и подобных программных модулей, которые вносят изменения или влияют на работу веб-страниц AliExpress (действует для всех ГЕО):


	Расширениям браузера (plug-ins, add-ons, extensions) и подобным программным модулям запрещается автоматически открывать всплывающие окна (pop-up) и любые типы уведомлений на сайте AliExpress как в момент открытия пользователем сайта AliExpress, так и в процессе перемещения по нему. Только уведомления внутри иконки плагина (см. фото) являются допустимыми. Кроме того, расширениям запрещается модифицировать код сайта AliExpress, включая, но не ограничиваясь, встраиванием своих кнопок/текстовых блоков куда бы то ни было в сайт AliExpress.


Рекомендации по размещению ссылок на аффилиатные товары (товары продавцов AliExpress, которые участвуют в партнерской программе):


	Использование основной партнерской ссылки оффера из вашего личного кабинета. Основная ссылка ведет на best.aliexpress.com - это вариант главной страницы AliExpress, где все товары являются аффилиатными. 
	Если вы продвигаете отдельные товары, вы сможете проверить их на аффилиатность с помощью инструмента "Тестер ссылок" в личном кабинете Admitad. Туда необходимо вставить партнерский диплинк, если товар не является аффилиатным, появится соответствующее предупреждение. Кроме того, аффилиатность товара можно проверить с помощью нашего API в два шага:



	Пользователь проверяет прямую ссылку на товар. Из прямой ссылки веб-мастеру необходимо сгенерировать партнерскую с помощью метода Генератор deeplink https://developers.admitad.com/ru/doc/api_ru/methods/deeplink/deeplink/.
	Проверить партнерскую ссылку с помощью метода Тестирование ссылок https://developers.admitad.com/ru/doc/api_ru/methods/links/links/. Если ссылка ведет на аффилиатный товар, АПИ вернет ответ "Ссылка успешно протестирована". Если ссылка ведет на неаффилиатный товар, АПИ вернет ответ "Внимание, данный товар не является аффилиатным".



	Вы также можете брать ссылки из товарных фидов AliExpress, там содержатся только аффилиатные товары. 


Более подробно ознакомиться с информацией об Антиспам отчетах от Aliexpress вы можете ознакомиться здесь.

Список минус слов вы можете скачать по ссылке

Обратите внимание, что контекст на бренд строго запрещен. Вы не можете использовать название бренда Aliexpress в качестве ключевого слова, в том числе название бренда, написанное с ошибкой, написанное частично или в сочетании с другим словом.

content.headline: Save Money & Space with nuvoH2O's Salt-Free Water Softener
content.subheadline: Protect your home from hard water damage without salt, electricity, or maintenance.
content.intro: Hard water leaves scale buildup, dry skin, and wasted energy. nuvoH2O offers a salt-free, compact water softener that installs easily and requires no electricity or ongoing maintenance. Protect your pipes and appliances while enjoying softer water.

benefits.title: No Salt or Electricity
benefits.description: Operates without salt, electricity, or wastewater, making it eco-friendly and low-maintenance.

benefits.title: Compact Design
benefits.description: Small footprint fits under sinks or in tight spaces, ideal for homes and apartments.

benefits.title: Prevents Scale Buildup
benefits.description: Reduces hard water scale in pipes, water heaters, and appliances, extending their lifespan.

benefits.title: Easy Installation
benefits.description: Simple DIY installation with no plumbing modifications required.

benefits.title: Low Maintenance
benefits.description: No salt bags, no regeneration cycles, no ongoing costs beyond initial purchase.

benefits.title: Better for Skin & Hair
benefits.description: Soft water reduces dryness and irritation, leaving skin and hair feeling smoother.

howItWorks: Water flows through the nuvoH2O cartridge containing chelation crystals.
Crystals bind to calcium and magnesium ions, preventing scale formation.
Softened water flows to your faucets, protecting pipes and appliances.
Replace the cartridge every 6-12 months (depending on usage and water hardness).

faq.question: Does nuvoH2O remove existing scale?
faq.answer: It prevents new scale buildup but does not remove existing scale. For severe scale, pre-cleaning may be needed.

faq.question: How often do I need to replace the cartridge?
faq.answer: Typically every 6-12 months, depending on water hardness and usage. A replacement indicator is included.

faq.question: Is nuvoH2O suitable for well water?
faq.answer: Yes, it works with both municipal and well water, but very high iron or sediment may require pre-filtration.

faq.question: Does it require electricity or plumbing changes?
faq.answer: No electricity needed. Installation is simple—connect to your existing cold water line under a sink.

faq.question: Will it make water feel slippery like salt-based softeners?
faq.answer: No, it conditions water without removing minerals, so it feels natural—not slippery.

faq.question: What is the warranty?
faq.answer: nuvoH2O offers a limited lifetime warranty on the unit and a satisfaction guarantee. Check their site for details.

content.headline: Master Outdoor Cooking with Traeger Grills
content.subheadline: Explore the world of wood-fired flavor with Traeger’s innovative pellet grills—precision, versatility, and taste in every meal.
content.intro: Traeger Grills revolutionized outdoor cooking with their wood pellet technology, offering a unique blend of smoky flavor and precise temperature control. Whether you’re a seasoned pitmaster or a backyard enthusiast, Traeger grills make it easy to grill, smoke, bake, roast, and more. Discover how Traeger can elevate your cooking game.

benefits.title: Wood-Fired Flavor
benefits.description: Traeger’s 100% wood pellets infuse your food with authentic, smoky taste that gas or charcoal can’t match.

benefits.title: Precise Temperature Control
benefits.description: Digital controllers maintain consistent heat from 165°F to 500°F, so you can smoke low and slow or sear hot and fast.

benefits.title: Versatile Cooking
benefits.description: Grill, smoke, bake, roast, braise, and barbecue—all in one grill. From brisket to pizza, Traeger does it all.

benefits.title: WiFIRE Technology
benefits.description: Control your grill from your smartphone with the Traeger app. Monitor temperature, adjust settings, and access recipes remotely.

benefits.title: Easy to Use
benefits.description: Just set the temperature and let the grill do the work. No tending to coals or managing gas levels—perfect for beginners and pros.

benefits.title: Durable Construction
benefits.description: Built with heavy-gauge steel and a powder-coated finish, Traeger grills are designed to last through seasons of outdoor cooking.

howItWorks: Fill the hopper with Traeger wood pellets—choose from flavors like hickory, apple, or mesquite.
Set your desired temperature using the digital controller or the WiFIRE app.
Place your food on the grill grates and let the pellet auger feed wood into the firepot for consistent heat and smoke.
Cook with confidence: the grill automatically adjusts airflow and pellet feed to maintain your set temperature.
Enjoy your perfectly cooked meal with deep, wood-fired flavor that’s hard to beat.

faq.question: What is a pellet grill and how does it differ from a gas or charcoal grill?
faq.answer: A pellet grill uses compressed wood pellets as fuel, providing both heat and smoke for authentic wood-fired flavor. Unlike gas or charcoal, it offers precise temperature control and the ability to smoke, grill, bake, and more in one unit.

faq.question: Do I need to use Traeger brand pellets?
faq.answer: While you can use other brands, Traeger pellets are specifically formulated for optimal performance and flavor. They produce less ash and are made from 100% hardwood without fillers.

faq.question: Can I use a Traeger grill in the rain or cold weather?
faq.answer: Yes, Traeger grills are designed for year-round use. They are weather-resistant, but it’s best to keep the grill covered when not in use. Cold weather may require slightly longer preheat times.

faq.question: How do I clean and maintain my Traeger grill?
faq.answer: Regular cleaning includes emptying the ash after several uses, cleaning the grates, and covering the grill. Deep cleaning involves vacuuming the firepot and grease management system. Refer to the manual for detailed instructions.

faq.question: What is the warranty on Traeger grills?
faq.answer: Most Traeger grills come with a limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. The length varies by model, typically ranging from 3 to 10 years. Check the specific product page for details.

faq.question: Can I use Traeger grills indoors?
faq.answer: No, Traeger grills are designed for outdoor use only. They produce smoke and require proper ventilation. Using them indoors poses a fire and carbon monoxide hazard.

content.metaTitle: Traeger Grills Review: Wood-Fired Flavor Made Easy
content.metaDescription: Discover Traeger wood pellet grills for authentic smoky flavor, precise temperature control, and versatile cooking. Perfect for beginners and pros.

content.headline: Smart Cat Litter That Monitors Health
content.subheadline: Pretty Litter changes color to detect early signs of illness in your cat, making litter box cleaning effortless.
content.intro: Pretty Litter is a revolutionary silica gel cat litter that not only controls odor and moisture better than clay litter but also acts as a health monitoring system. benefits.title: Health Monitoring
benefits.description: Color-changing crystals detect pH, blood, and other indicators of common feline health problems, giving you peace of mind.

benefits.title: Superior Odor Control
benefits.description: Silica gel absorbs liquid and traps odors instantly, keeping your home fresh for up to 30 days with one bag.

benefits.title: Low Dust & Lightweight
benefits.description: 99% dust-free and 40% lighter than clay litter, making it easier to handle and healthier for cats with respiratory issues.

benefits.title: Easy Cleanup
benefits.description: Simply scoop solids and stir; no heavy clumps to haul. The crystals absorb urine and dry out waste, reducing mess.

benefits.description: A single bag lasts up to a month for one cat, reducing the frequency of litter changes and saving you money.

howItWorks: Fill your clean litter box with 2–3 inches of Pretty Litter.
Scoop solid waste daily and stir the crystals to expose fresh litter.
Observe litter color changes: normal is light yellow to amber; green, blue, or red may indicate health issues.
Replace entire litter monthly (or more often if heavily soiled) and wash the box.

faq.question: How does Pretty Litter monitor health?
faq.answer: The crystals contain a pH indicator that changes color when urine has abnormal pH levels. It can also detect blood (blue) and other markers. Always consult a vet for diagnosis.

faq.question: Is Pretty Litter safe for kittens?
faq.answer: Yes, it is non-toxic and safe for kittens once they are litter trained. The low dust formula is gentle on young respiratory systems.

faq.question: How often should I change the litter?
faq.answer: For one cat, replace the entire box once a month. For multiple cats, you may need to change every 2–3 weeks depending on usage.

faq.question: Does it control odor better than clay litter?
faq.answer: Yes, silica gel absorbs and traps odors rather than masking them. Many users report no smell for weeks.

faq.question: Can I flush Pretty Litter?
faq.answer: No, it should not be flushed. Dispose of used litter in the trash as it can clog pipes.

faq.question: What if my cat doesn't like the texture?
faq.answer: Most cats adapt quickly. If your cat is hesitant, mix a small amount of their old litter with Pretty Litter and gradually increase the ratio.

content.headline: Preserve Every Drop with Coravin Wine Systems
content.subheadline: Pour wine by the glass without pulling the cork – enjoy fresh wine for weeks or even years.
content.intro: Discover the award-winning Coravin wine preservation system, available now in Australia. Whether you're a casual enthusiast or a serious collector, Coravin lets you pour a single glass without compromising the rest of the bottle. Experience wine on your terms, with technology trusted by sommeliers worldwide.

benefits.title: Pour Without Pulling the Cork
benefits.description: Coravin uses a thin needle to access wine through the cork, then replaces the volume with inert argon gas, preventing oxidation.

benefits.title: Enjoy Fresh Wine for Months or Years
benefits.description: Preserved bottles stay fresh for up to 3 months with standard models, or indefinitely with Coravin's higher-end systems.

benefits.title: Taste Before You Commit
benefits.description: Sample a glass from any bottle in your collection without opening it – perfect for checking maturity or pairing decisions.

benefits.title: No More Waste from Half-Empty Bottles
benefits.description: Save money and reduce waste by drinking only what you want, when you want. The rest stays perfectly preserved.

benefits.title: Professional-Grade Technology for Home Use
benefits.description: Trusted by top restaurants and wineries, Coravin brings commercial-quality preservation to your kitchen or cellar.

howItWorks: Insert the Coravin needle through the cork – no need to remove it.
Pour your desired amount of wine while argon gas fills the bottle to prevent oxidation.
Remove the needle – the cork reseals naturally, keeping the remaining wine fresh.
Enjoy your glass immediately or store the bottle upright for later use.

faq.question: Does Coravin work with all wine bottles?
faq.answer: Coravin works best with natural corks. It is not recommended for screw caps or synthetic corks, as they may not reseal properly.

faq.question: How long does the wine stay fresh?
faq.answer: Depending on the model, wine can stay fresh for up to 3 months or more. The higher-end Timeless models preserve wine indefinitely.

faq.question: Is the argon gas safe?
faq.answer: Yes, argon is an inert, food-safe gas used in wine preservation. It is odorless, tasteless, and harmless.

faq.question: Can I use Coravin with sparkling wine?
faq.answer: No, Coravin is designed for still wines only. Using it with sparkling wine will cause loss of carbonation.

faq.question: Do I need to replace the gas capsules?
faq.answer: Yes, each capsule provides approximately 15 pours (150ml each). Replacement capsules are available from Coravin Australia.

faq.question: Is it easy to clean?
faq.answer: Yes, the needle and system require minimal maintenance. Simply wipe the needle with a damp cloth after each use.

faq.question: How much compensation can I get?
faq.answer: Under EU law, you can claim up to €600 per passenger, depending on the flight distance and delay length. Use AirHelp's free calculator to estimate your claim.

faq.answer: Most claims are resolved within a few weeks, but complex cases may take longer. AirHelp provides regular updates on your claim status.

faq.answer: No, travel insurance is not required. AirHelp helps you claim directly from the airline under passenger rights regulations.

content.subheadline: Protect your passwords, secrets, and digital identity with enterprise-grade security trusted by millions.
content.intro: In an era where data breaches are inevitable, Keeper Security provides the most robust password management and online protection platform. Whether you're an individual or a business, Keeper simplifies security without compromising on strength.

benefits.title: Zero-Trust Security Model
benefits.description: Keeper uses a zero-trust architecture, meaning your data is encrypted on your device before it ever reaches their servers. Even Keeper cannot see your passwords.

benefits.title: BreachWatch Dark Web Monitoring
benefits.description: Get real-time alerts if your credentials appear on the dark web, so you can take action immediately to prevent account takeover.

benefits.title: Secure File Storage & Sharing
benefits.description: Store and share sensitive documents with end-to-end encryption. Control access with expiration dates and revoke permissions anytime.

benefits.title: Cross-Platform Accessibility
benefits.description: Access your vault from any device – Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, Linux, and browser extensions. Your passwords sync seamlessly.

benefits.title: Biometric & Multi-Factor Authentication
benefits.description: Add an extra layer of security with fingerprint, face ID, and hardware key support. Keeper supports TOTP, SMS, and more.

benefits.title: Emergency Access & Account Recovery
benefits.description: Designate trusted contacts who can access your vault in an emergency. Never get locked out of your own accounts.

howItWorks: Create your secure vault – sign up with just an email and a master password that only you know.
Install Keeper on all your devices and browser extensions. It will automatically detect and save new logins.
Import existing passwords from your browser or other managers using the built-in import tool.
Enable BreachWatch to monitor for compromised credentials and receive instant alerts.
Share passwords and files securely with family or colleagues, setting expiration dates and permissions.

faq.question: Is Keeper Security free?
faq.answer: Keeper offers a limited free tier for basic password management. Premium plans with advanced features like BreachWatch and secure file storage start at a low monthly cost. Visit the official site for current pricing.

faq.question: How does Keeper encrypt my data?
faq.answer: Keeper uses AES-256 encryption with a unique encryption key derived from your master password. Data is encrypted on your device before transmission, ensuring zero-knowledge.

faq.question: Can I use Keeper for my business?
faq.answer: Yes, Keeper offers enterprise plans with centralized admin controls, role-based access, and compliance reporting. It's ideal for teams of any size.

faq.question: What happens if I forget my master password?
faq.answer: Keeper offers account recovery options like security questions and emergency access. However, since Keeper has zero-knowledge, you must set up recovery in advance.

faq.question: Does Keeper work with all websites and apps?
faq.answer: Keeper's browser extensions and mobile apps auto-fill passwords on most websites and apps. It also supports biometric login on compatible devices.

faq.question: Is my data safe if Keeper's servers are hacked?
faq.answer: Yes. Because your data is encrypted locally and never decrypted on Keeper's servers, even a server breach would not expose your passwords or files.

faq.answer: You can use vacuum-seal bags or high-quality zip-lock bags designed for sous vide. Ensure they are BPA-free and heat-resistant.

faq.answer: Yes, you can cook frozen food sous vide. Just add extra time to account for the thawing process.

faq.answer: The Anova app provides guided recipes, allows you to control the cooker remotely, and sends notifications when cooking is complete.

faq.answer: Wipe the exterior with a damp cloth. Descale the heating element periodically using a vinegar solution to maintain performance.

content.subheadline: Alimentez votre vie en déplacement avec des stations d'énergie fiables et écologiques.
content.intro: Que vous soyez un aventurier, un télétravailleur nomade ou que vous cherchiez une solution de secours pour votre maison, BLUETTI propose des générateurs solaires et des batteries portables de haute qualité. benefits.description: Avec des capacités allant de 200Wh à plusieurs kWh, BLUETTI peut alimenter vos appareils essentiels pendant des heures, voire des jours.

benefits.title: Recharge rapide et polyvalente
benefits.description: Rechargez via des panneaux solaires, une prise secteur ou une voiture. La technologie de charge rapide vous fait gagner un temps précieux.

benefits.description: Surveillez et gérez votre consommation d'énergie à distance grâce à l'application mobile intuitive BLUETTI.

benefits.description: Conçus pour résister aux conditions difficiles, les produits BLUETTI sont à la fois légers et durables, faciles à transporter.

howItWorks: Choisissez votre modèle BLUETTI en fonction de vos besoins énergétiques (capacité, ports, etc.).
Rechargez la batterie via des panneaux solaires, une prise murale ou l'allume-cigare de votre voiture.
Connectez vos appareils (téléphone, ordinateur, réfrigérateur, etc.) aux ports AC/DC/USB.
Utilisez l'application BLUETTI pour surveiller la charge et ajuster les paramètres à distance.

faq.question: Quelle est la durée de vie des batteries BLUETTI ?
faq.answer: Les batteries BLUETTI utilisent des cellules LiFePO4, offrant plus de 3500 cycles de charge à 80% de capacité, soit environ 10 ans d'utilisation régulière.

faq.question: Puis-je utiliser un panneau solaire non-BLUETTI ?
faq.answer: Oui, la plupart des stations BLUETTI sont compatibles avec les panneaux solaires standards via des connecteurs MC4, mais vérifiez les spécifications de tension et de puissance.

faq.question: Les générateurs BLUETTI sont-ils sûrs pour une utilisation en intérieur ?
faq.answer: Absolument. Ils n'émettent aucun gaz nocif et sont équipés d'un système de gestion de batterie (BMS) pour prévenir les surcharges, courts-circuits et surchauffes.

faq.question: Quelle est la garantie des produits BLUETTI ?
faq.answer: BLUETTI offre généralement une garantie de 2 à 5 ans selon le modèle. Consultez la page produit pour les détails spécifiques.

faq.question: Puis-je faire fonctionner un réfrigérateur avec une station BLUETTI ?
faq.answer: Oui, les modèles avec une capacité suffisante (par exemple, AC200P ou AC300) peuvent alimenter un réfrigérateur pendant plusieurs heures. Vérifiez la consommation de votre appareil.

content.headline: Carbonify: Turn CO₂ into Valuable Carbon Black
content.subheadline: Join the climate tech revolution – Carbonify's innovative process captures CO₂ and converts it into high-quality carbon black for industrial use.
content.intro: Carbonify is a pioneering German startup that transforms carbon dioxide emissions into valuable carbon black, a key material used in tires, plastics, and batteries. By leveraging proprietary technology, they offer a scalable solution for carbon capture and utilization (CCU), helping industries reduce their environmental footprint while producing a resource in high demand. Discover how Carbonify is turning a climate challenge into an economic opportunity.

benefits.title: CO₂ to Valuable Material
benefits.description: Carbonify's process captures CO₂ from industrial sources and converts it into carbon black, a material with a global market worth billions.

benefits.title: Climate Positive Impact
benefits.description: Each kilogram of carbon black produced sequesters up to 3 kg of CO₂, directly reducing greenhouse gas emissions.

benefits.title: Industrial Scalability
benefits.description: The technology is designed to integrate with existing industrial facilities, enabling large-scale deployment without major infrastructure changes.

benefits.title: Circular Economy
benefits.description: Carbon black from CO₂ can replace fossil-based carbon black in tires, plastics, and batteries, closing the carbon loop.

benefits.title: Economic Viability
benefits.description: With rising carbon prices and demand for sustainable materials, Carbonify offers a profitable pathway for industries to decarbonize.

howItWorks: Carbonify captures CO₂ from industrial exhaust streams using advanced absorption technology.
The captured CO₂ is then fed into a proprietary electrolysis reactor that splits it into carbon black and oxygen.
The resulting carbon black is purified and processed into a fine powder ready for use in manufacturing.
The oxygen byproduct can be reused or released, making the process nearly zero-waste.

faq.question: What is carbon black and why is it important?
faq.answer: Carbon black is a fine black powder used as a reinforcing agent in tires, a pigment in plastics and inks, and a conductive additive in batteries. It is a multi-billion dollar global market.

faq.question: How does Carbonify's technology differ from other carbon capture methods?
faq.answer: Unlike traditional carbon capture and storage (CCS), Carbonify's process converts CO₂ into a valuable product, creating economic incentives for adoption. It also operates at lower temperatures and pressures, reducing energy costs.

faq.question: Is Carbonify's carbon black as good as conventional carbon black?
faq.answer: Yes, independent tests show that Carbonify's carbon black meets or exceeds industry standards for purity and performance in applications like tires and plastics.

faq.question: What industries can benefit from Carbonify?
faq.answer: Industries with high CO₂ emissions (cement, steel, chemicals) can use Carbonify to reduce their carbon footprint. Manufacturers of tires, plastics, and batteries can source sustainable carbon black.

faq.question: Is Carbonify available for partnership or investment?
faq.answer: Carbonify is actively seeking industrial partners and investors to scale their technology. Visit their website for more information on collaboration opportunities.

content.metaTitle: Carbonify: CO₂ to Carbon Black Technology
content.metaDescription: Carbonify converts CO₂ into valuable carbon black for tires, plastics, and batteries. Learn how this German startup is revolutionizing carbon capture and utilization.

content.headline: EVM: Tiefengeothermie für nachhaltige Wärme
content.subheadline: Entdecken Sie, wie EVM mit innovativer Geothermie-Technologie zuverlässige und umweltfreundliche Wärmeversorgung ermöglicht.
content.intro: EVM ist ein führender Anbieter von Tiefengeothermie-Lösungen in Deutschland. Mit modernster Technologie nutzt das Unternehmen die natürliche Wärme aus der Erde, um Haushalte und Unternehmen effizient und nachhaltig mit Wärme zu versorgen. Erfahren Sie, wie EVM die Energiewende aktiv mitgestaltet.

benefits.title: Nachhaltige Wärme
benefits.description: Nutzung der natürlichen Erdwärme reduziert CO₂-Emissionen und schont die Umwelt.

benefits.title: Zuverlässige Versorgung
benefits.description: Tiefengeothermie bietet eine konstante und wetterunabhängige Wärmequelle.

benefits.title: Kosteneffizienz
benefits.description: Langfristig niedrigere Heizkosten durch effiziente Geothermie-Nutzung.

benefits.title: Regionale Wertschöpfung
benefits.description: EVM setzt auf lokale Projekte, stärkt die regionale Wirtschaft und schafft Arbeitsplätze.

benefits.title: Innovative Technologie
benefits.description: Modernste Bohr- und Fördertechnik für maximale Effizienz und Sicherheit.

howItWorks: Erkundung: Geologische Untersuchungen identifizieren geeignete Standorte für Geothermie-Projekte.
Bohrung: Mit speziellen Bohrverfahren werden mehrere tausend Meter tiefe Bohrlöcher erstellt.
Förderung: Heißes Thermalwasser wird an die Oberfläche gefördert und seine Wärme wird genutzt.
Verteilung: Die gewonnene Wärme wird über Fernwärmenetze an Haushalte und Betriebe verteilt.
Rückführung: Das abgekühlte Wasser wird zurück in die Erde geleitet, um den Kreislauf zu schließen.

faq.question: Was ist Tiefengeothermie?
faq.answer: Tiefengeothermie nutzt die natürliche Wärme aus dem Erdinneren, die in tiefen Gesteinsschichten gespeichert ist. Durch Bohrungen wird heißes Thermalwasser gefördert, dessen Wärme zur Heizung und Warmwasserbereitung genutzt wird.

faq.question: Ist Geothermie umweltfreundlich?
faq.answer: Ja, Geothermie ist eine erneuerbare Energiequelle mit geringen CO₂-Emissionen. Sie ist wetterunabhängig und liefert kontinuierlich Energie, was sie zu einer nachhaltigen Alternative zu fossilen Brennstoffen macht.

faq.question: In welchen Regionen ist EVM aktiv?
faq.answer: EVM ist hauptsächlich in Deutschland tätig und realisiert Projekte in verschiedenen Regionen mit geeigneten geologischen Bedingungen.

faq.question: Wie lange dauert ein Geothermie-Projekt?
faq.answer: Die Planung und Umsetzung eines Geothermie-Projekts kann mehrere Jahre in Anspruch nehmen, abhängig von Genehmigungsverfahren und geologischen Gegebenheiten.

faq.question: Ist Geothermie sicher?
faq.answer: Ja, moderne Technologien und strenge Sicherheitsstandards gewährleisten einen sicheren Betrieb. Erdbebenrisiken sind bei sachgemäßer Durchführung minimal.

content.metaTitle: EVM Tiefengeothermie – Nachhaltige Wärme aus der Erde
content.metaDescription: EVM nutzt Tiefengeothermie für umweltfreundliche Wärmeversorgung in Deutschland. Erfahren Sie mehr über die innovative Technologie und ihre Vorteile.

faq.answer: It uses electrolysis to split water molecules and dissolve hydrogen gas into the water, creating hydrogen-rich water in minutes.

benefits.title: Authentic UMF™ Grading
benefits.description: Every jar is independently tested and rated with the Unique Manuka Factor (UMF™) to guarantee antibacterial potency.

benefits.title: Sourced from New Zealand
benefits.description: Harvested from pristine manuka bushes in remote regions of New Zealand, ensuring high-quality raw ingredients.

benefits.description: Manuka honey is known for its natural antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, helping to strengthen your body's defenses.

benefits.description: Enjoy it by the spoonful, stirred into tea, drizzled over yogurt, or used as a natural sweetener in recipes.

benefits.description: Committed to sustainable beekeeping practices that protect bee populations and the environment.

howItWorks: Browse the Manuka Doctor collection to find the UMF™ rating that suits your needs (from 10+ to 20+).
Add your chosen jar to the cart and proceed to checkout on the official site.
Enter your shipping details for delivery across the UK and Germany.
Enjoy your pure Manuka honey—store at room temperature and use as desired.

faq.question: What is UMF™ and why does it matter?
faq.answer: UMF™ (Unique Manuka Factor) is the globally recognized grading system that measures the antibacterial potency of Manuka honey. A higher UMF™ indicates stronger antibacterial activity.

faq.question: How should I store Manuka honey?
faq.answer: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Do not refrigerate, as it may crystallize. If crystallization occurs, gently warm the jar in warm water.

faq.question: Is Manuka Doctor honey suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes, but it is not recommended for infants under 12 months due to the risk of botulism. For older children, consult your pediatrician for appropriate dosage.

faq.question: What is the difference between UMF™ and MGO?
faq.answer: MGO (methylglyoxal) is the compound responsible for antibacterial activity. UMF™ is a broader quality indicator that includes MGO plus other marker compounds. Both are listed on Manuka Doctor jars.

faq.question: Can I use Manuka honey for wound care?
faq.answer: Medical-grade Manuka honey is used in clinical wound care. However, for topical use, consult a healthcare professional. Our honey is intended for dietary use.

faq.question: Do you ship to my country?
faq.answer: Manuka Doctor ships to the United Kingdom and Germany. Check their site for current shipping policies and any restrictions.

Download the Mbito app from the App Store or Google Play and pair via Bluetooth.
Launch the app and select your vehicle model. The app will automatically identify your car.
Choose a diagnostic function (e.g., read fault codes, live data, or special functions) and follow on-screen instructions.

faq.answer: Yes, the Mbito app is available for both iOS and Android devices. A Bluetooth connection is required.

faq.answer: Yes. Mysterium uses a decentralized network with no central logs, and your traffic is encrypted. The open-source code has been independently audited.

faq.answer: Unlike centralized VPNs, Mysterium has no single point of failure or data collection. Nodes are operated by independent users, not a corporate server farm.

faq.answer: Mysterium is available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Browser extensions are also available.

content.intro: L'hiver peut être rude, mais avec Warm-on, vous restez au chaud sans compromis sur le style. Notre technologie de vêtements chauffants connectés vous offre une liberté de mouvement et une autonomie inégalée. Découvrez comment nos solutions innovantes transforment votre expérience du froid.

benefits.title: Chauffage intelligent
benefits.description: Des zones de chaleur ciblées avec contrôle via application mobile pour une température personnalisée.

benefits.title: Autonomie longue durée
benefits.description: Batterie rechargeable offrant jusqu'à 8 heures de chaleur continue selon le réglage.

benefits.description: Vêtements modernes et discrets qui s'intègrent parfaitement à votre garde-robe quotidienne.

howItWorks: 1. Choisissez votre vêtement chauffant parmi notre gamme (veste, gilet, etc.).
2. Connectez l'application Warm-on à votre vêtement via Bluetooth.
3. Réglez la température et activez la chaleur directement depuis votre smartphone.
4. Profitez d'une chaleur douce et homogène pendant des heures.
5. Rechargez la batterie facilement avec le câble USB fourni.

faq.question: Comment fonctionne le chauffage ?
faq.answer: Les vêtements Warm-on intègrent des éléments chauffants en fibre de carbone, alimentés par une batterie rechargeable. La chaleur est diffusée de manière homogène sur les zones clés (dos, poitrine).

faq.question: Quelle est l'autonomie de la batterie ?
faq.answer: Selon le niveau de chaleur sélectionné, l'autonomie varie de 3 à 8 heures. La batterie se recharge en 2-3 heures via USB.

faq.question: Puis-je laver mon vêtement chauffant ?
faq.answer: Oui, retirez la batterie et l'électronique, puis lavez le vêtement en machine à 30°C. Les composants électroniques ne sont pas lavables.

benefits.description: Once approved, compensation is typically paid directly to your account within weeks.

faq.answer: Delays over 3 hours, cancellations within 14 days of departure, and denied boarding due to overbooking may qualify.

benefits.title: Long-Lasting LiFePO4 Batteries
benefits.description: Bluetti uses lithium iron phosphate cells that last 3,500+ cycles to 80% capacity, providing over 10 years of daily use.

benefits.title: Fast Solar Charging
benefits.description: With MPPT charge controllers, Bluetti power stations can recharge from solar panels in as little as 2-3 hours, maximizing your renewable energy use.

benefits.title: Expandable Capacity
benefits.description: Many models support add-on battery packs, allowing you to scale from a weekend trip to whole-home backup without buying a new unit.

benefits.description: Unlike gas generators, Bluetti power stations operate silently with zero fumes, making them safe for indoor use and quiet campsites.

benefits.description: Built-in BMS protects against overvoltage, short circuits, and temperature extremes, ensuring your devices stay safe.

benefits.title: Versatile Output Options
benefits.description: Multiple AC, USB-C, USB-A, and DC ports let you power everything from laptops and CPAP machines to power tools and refrigerators.

howItWorks: Choose your power station based on capacity needs (e.g., AC200P for home backup, EB70S for camping).
Connect solar panels (sold separately) to the built-in MPPT input for clean, free energy from the sun.
Plug in your devices directly via AC, USB, or DC ports – or use the transfer switch to connect to your home's breaker panel.
Monitor power usage and settings via the LCD screen or Bluetti app for real-time control.
Expand storage by adding extra battery modules when you need more runtime.

faq.answer: With 200W solar input, an AC200P can charge in about 3-4 hours in full sun. Actual time depends on panel wattage and sunlight conditions.

faq.answer: Yes, most models allow simultaneous solar/AC charging while powering devices, though it may reduce battery lifespan if done constantly.

faq.answer: Bluetti offers a 2-year warranty on all power stations and batteries, with an optional extended warranty available.

faq.answer: Yes, with a transfer switch and a high-capacity model like the AC300 or EP500, you can power essential circuits (lights, fridge, internet) for hours.

content.headline: Welcome the Night Shift: The Big Bat Box
content.subheadline: Give bats a safe, spacious home and naturally control pests in your backyard.
content.intro: Bats are nature's most effective pest controllers, consuming thousands of insects each night. The Big Bat Box offers a premium, handcrafted shelter that attracts these beneficial creatures to your property. Help restore bat populations while reducing mosquitoes and garden pests—without chemicals.

benefits.title: Natural Pest Control
benefits.description: A single bat can eat up to 1,000 mosquitoes per hour. Your Big Bat Box will attract a colony that keeps your yard insect-free naturally.

benefits.title: Expert Craftsmanship
benefits.description: Made from durable, untreated cedar with a dark interior and textured landing pad, designed to mimic natural roosts and maximize occupancy.

benefits.title: Easy Installation
benefits.description: Mounts on poles, trees, or buildings with included hardware. Simple setup instructions ensure you attract bats quickly.

benefits.title: Eco-Friendly & Safe
benefits.description: Non-toxic materials and a design that protects bats from predators. Supports local ecosystems without harming the environment.

benefits.title: Proven Design
benefits.description: Based on bat house research from Bat Conservation International, featuring a 4-chamber design that accommodates large colonies.

benefits.title: Low Maintenance
benefits.description: Once installed, the Big Bat Box requires no upkeep. Bats are clean, and the house naturally ventilates to prevent mold.

howItWorks: Choose a sunny, south-facing location (at least 15-20 feet high) near a water source and away from bright lights.
Mount the Big Bat Box securely using the provided hardware. Ensure it is stable and out of reach of pets.
Wait patiently. Bats may discover the box within weeks or months. Avoid disturbing the box once bats move in.
Enjoy natural pest control and observe nightly flights at dusk. The box will house a colony for years with no maintenance.

faq.question: Will bats really use this box?
faq.answer: Yes, when properly placed in a suitable habitat. The Big Bat Box is designed to meet bat preferences for temperature, height, and texture, making it highly attractive to common North American bat species.

faq.question: Is it safe to have bats near my home?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Bats are not aggressive and avoid humans. They provide significant benefits by controlling insects. The box is placed away from living areas, and bats will not enter your home.

faq.question: How long until bats move in?
faq.answer: It can take from a few weeks to over a year. Factors like local bat populations, placement, and season affect timing. Patience is key; many users see occupancy within the first summer.

faq.question: Do I need to clean the bat house?
faq.answer: No. Bats are clean animals, and the house is self-cleaning. Guano (droppings) falls out the bottom, providing natural fertilizer for nearby plants. Never disturb bats during occupancy.

faq.question: What if the box doesn't attract bats?
faq.answer: Check placement: it should get 6-8 hours of sun, be at least 15 feet high, and near water. If still empty after two seasons, consider moving it to a better location.

faq.question: Is the Big Bat Box guaranteed?
faq.answer: The manufacturer offers a satisfaction guarantee. If you're not happy, contact customer support. Specific terms are available on the product page.
